two-top/d8bf96f:
The wasm build has been deployed to Pages the whole time, and it is the
only way an iPhone plays this game — no APK to sideload, and a native
iOS port needs a paid account, a Mac, and every platform seam ported.
So the question was never how to reach iOS. It was why nobody had ever
played it in a browser. Four reasons:

- touch controls were never DRAWN on the web. TouchControlsPlugin gated
  `shown` on cfg!(target_os = "android"), while InputTouchPlugin is
  registered unconditionally — so on a phone browser the stick, throw
  and dash all worked, invisibly. Android hides the gate; a desktop
  browser has a keyboard to cover for it; an iPhone has neither. The
  gate now names the real condition: any target whose only input device
  is a finger.

- nothing persisted, ever. paths::config_dir fell through to
  dirs::config_dir(), which is None on wasm32 where every std::fs call
  returns Unsupported — so every save silently did nothing. A fresh
  install-id was minted on EVERY page load, with the name grid and an
  empty rivalry ledger behind it. The three document seams
  (read_document, write_atomic, quarantine_corrupt) now dispatch to
  localStorage under a two-top/ namespace, keeping the four persisted
  documents in their exact native shape and the corrupt-bytes promise
  intact. Every access degrades to in-memory rather than panicking,
  because Safari private mode makes localStorage throw, not vanish.
  shared_dir stays None on the web and now says why: tapes and crash
  logs are files a human opens, and a page cannot leave one.

- no Add to Home Screen. Generated icons (from the duelist sheet and
  the locked palette, so they cannot drift), a manifest for
  Android/desktop, and the apple-* tags iOS reads instead of it. The
  viewport stops double-tap zoom, and the canvas sizes in dvh — iOS
  Safari's vh is the TALLEST the viewport ever gets, so 100vh put the
  dash button under the URL bar.

- the bundle. wasm-opt -Oz now runs on the deploy. The measured resul

plant page shows and had no "+" on either, so the same field was fillable in one

her guide, and no account, no server-side user data and no PII is a property to
